// Package internal is the "after" half of the line-shift fixture pair. The
// guard below is byte-identical to testdata/shift/before, and everything above
// it is the unrelated edit: a license header, a package comment, an import, and
// one new function. The guard moved from line 8 to line 22 and nothing about
// the guard changed.
package internal

import "fmt"

type Server struct {
	authorizer interface{}
}

func (s *Server) Describe() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("server %p", s)
}

func (s *Server) HandleX() error {
	if s.authorizer == nil {
		return nil
	}
	_ = s.authorizer
	return nil
}
